content.short: Meta Panthers is an NFT collection on TON with Telegram integration and a 5,000-piece collection.
content.description: Meta Panthers presents itself as an early NFT project on the TON blockchain integrated with Telegram. The project site describes a 5,000-piece collection and points collectors toward Telegram channels, marketplace activity, and community apps. It belongs under NFT dapps because the core product is collection ownership and community around those NFTs. Meta Panthers is the first NFT project on the TON platform to integrate with Telegram. The experience is organized around скачивайте приложения, download our apps, подписывайтесь на нас!, and follow social networks!.
